name: amazon-spapi
description: Pull Amazon Selling Partner API data - listings, orders, returns, sales and traffic - to local files.
long_description: Runs locally and holds your SP-API credentials on your own machine. Scoped to the Inventory and Order Tracking and Brand Analytics roles: merchant-fulfilled listings, orders, returns, and Brand Analytics reports. Includes probe_access, which empirically tests what your authorization actually permits, and fast Orders API tools that return in seconds rather than going through the report queue. Reports are saved as dated files in your chosen output folder; tools return only a small preview, so a large catalogue never floods the conversation. Connect the same output folder in Claude to read the full files.

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Verify credentials, region and marketplace without pulling any report data.

tools.name: probe_access
tools.description: Empirically test which reports and endpoints this authorization actually permits.

tools.name: list_report_types
tools.description: List the report keys this server can pull, grouped by the role each needs.

tools.name: list_saved_reports
tools.description: List report files already downloaded to the output folder.

tools.name: pull_report
tools.description: Pull one report over any span, auto-splitting past Amazon's 30/60-day caps.

tools.name: pull_standard_set
tools.description: Pull the merchant-fulfilled set: listings, orders, returns, sales and traffic.

tools.name: list_orders
tools.description: List recent orders via the Orders API - returns in seconds, not minutes.

tools.name: get_order_items
tools.description: Get the line items for a single order: SKU, ASIN, quantity, item price.

tools.name: sales_metrics
tools.description: Aggregated order count, units and revenue per time bucket from the Sales API.

python_path.title: Python interpreter
python_path.description: Full path to the python.exe that has requests, python-dotenv and mcp installed.

lwa_client_id.title: LWA Client ID
lwa_client_id.description: From Amazon Developer Central, your private app. Starts with amzn1.application-oa2-client.

lwa_client_secret.title: LWA Client Secret
lwa_client_secret.description: From Amazon Developer Central. Starts with amzn1.oa2-cs.v1.

lwa_refresh_token.title: LWA Refresh Token
lwa_refresh_token.description: From self-authorizing your own app. Starts with Atzr|.

spapi_region.title: SP-API region
spapi_region.description: na = North America | eu = Europe, UK, India, Middle East | fe = Japan, Australia, Singapore.

spapi_marketplace_id.title: Marketplace
spapi_marketplace_id.description: Country code (IN, US, UK, DE, AE...) or a raw marketplace id. Comma-separate for several in the same region.

output_dir.title: Report output folder
output_dir.description: Where downloaded reports are saved. Connect this same folder in Claude so it can read the full files.

spapi_timezone.title: Time zone for sales metrics
spapi_timezone.description: IANA time zone used to bucket Sales API metrics, e.g. Asia/Kolkata. UTC if unsure.
